oxford.en: n. a city in southern England to the northwest of London; site of Oxford University; n. a university town in northern Mississippi; home of William Faulkner

oxygen.en: n. a nonmetallic bivalent element that is normally a colorless odorless tasteless nonflammable diatomic gas; constitutes 21 percent of the atmosphere by volume…

oxygenated.en: v. impregnate, combine, or supply with oxygen
oxygenated.note: 充了氧的；氧化的；充满氧气的

oxygenating.en: v. impregnate, combine, or supply with oxygen

oxytocin.en: n. hormone secreted by the posterior pituitary gland (trade name Pitocin); stimulates contractions of the uterus and ejection of milk
